beats.narration: Checkpoint six: a comparison trace where a familiar platform got rejected, and three candidate fixes. If you haven't picked yours, pause and read the trace first.

Read the rejection reason: data processed outside the EU on the selected platform. That names the failed dimension — residency. So the answer is B: re-measure latency from EU-west, and select the platform whose region satisfies EU-only residency. The platform itself has to change. Option A optimizes the laptop-measured latency — a number measured from the wrong place, about a dimension that was never the problem. Option C adds caching to cut cost — also never the problem. Both treat dimensions the review didn't reject.

latency: measured from dev laptop      (wrong place)

✗ A — speed was never the problem
✗ C — cost was never the problem

beats.narration: The pattern to carry: fix the dimension named in the rejection, not the one that's easiest to improve. Next: trust boundaries.
